title: teslalog: Overview
description: A landing dashboard combining lifetime/today stats already computed elsewhere - matching TeslaMate's own Overview dashboard's role. teslalog's built-in portal already covers this same ground for a quick phone/laptop check (and needs no Grafana at all) - this exists for people who'd rather start from Grafana every time.

targets.queryText: SELECT display_name AS "Name", model AS "Model" FROM vehicles LIMIT 1

targets.queryText: SELECT end_odometer_km AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'Drives' AS "Dashboard", 'Every closed drive, click a date for the route map' AS "What it shows"
UNION ALL SELECT 'Charges', 'Every closed charging session'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Charging Stats', 'AC/DC split, totals, cost'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Timeline', 'State-machine history as colored bands'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Statistics', 'Per-month driving trends'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Locations', 'Most-visited places'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Vampire Drain', 'Battery lost while parked'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Projected Range', 'Range at 100% vs mileage - battery health trend'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Efficiency', 'Derived efficiency figures'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Mileage', 'Cumulative odometer'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Updates', 'Software update history'
